answer: Each of 192 aliases needs its own donor histories, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The horizon is the wall and the zenith is the gate: A blood donor history with donation centre records works as the gate: regular donations logged at the same centre over years. A farm of 192 aliases must climb the wall 192 times, the signal ledger shows every climb, and one honest agent walks through the gate once.
